status: Fictional, computed evaluation fixtures. Not real client results; never load them as live investor context.
verdict_caveat: Under the starter policy, green may mean an existing breach is reduced. portfolio_within_limits is computed separately from every gap_after. Do not rewrite the raw verdict or equate green with full compliance.

assumptions: Fictional test holdings expressed as CAD values.
Fixed prices and FX across hypothetical dates; no future return prediction.
No fees or taxes.
Future purchases are client-specified; none are executed.
fixtures.source_or_method: Python second_look.rules.evaluate_trade from the previously created local starter package; not the user's live deployed backend.

policy.allocation_source: NBF Investment Strategy Fall 2026 ranges supplied in project instructions; source document not independently verified in this package
assumptions: All non-allocation thresholds, asset mapping and color precedence are team assumptions.
HHI is sum of squared whole-portfolio position weights, including one cash bucket; no ETF look-through.
HHI watch begins at 0.15; new/worsened concentration above 0.25 is red. HHI uses index points, not the allocation 5-percentage-point buffer.
Near-limit warnings apply to meaningful asset-class boundaries only (exclude 0% minima and 100% maxima).
Strict improvement is green only if no breach is created or worsened; unchanged existing breaches remain yellow for review.
Single-stock, crypto and explicit exclusion breaches are red when created or worsened.
Sector limits require look-through for equity ETFs. Missing required coverage gives verdict null unless a definite red breach exists.
Cash-funded long-only trades; fractional units; zero fees and slippage; no automatic sale of ZST.TO for funding.
